wiki_article:
**Zbigniew Mrozony — Provenance Anchor (Heteronym of an External Author, New Human 2, 2015) — CORRECTED, supersedes 10.5281/zenodo.20628554** is a provenance document in the Crimson Hexagonal Archive, by Mrozony, Zbigniew (2026-07-03).

Zbigniew Mrozony (mrożony, "frozen") is the heteronym of an external author who contributed to New Human 2: A Distributed Journal of Voice (2015). Mrozony is the author of "38 Easy Steps to Carlyle's Everlasting Yea," which appears in the New Human 2 compiled double issue (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19652600).

*This entry opens from the work itself and awaits a composed article; the record's full text is seated and readable below.*
